summary: Phase 2 full build testing completed. Comprehensive frontend testing across desktop (1440px), tablet (768px, 1024px), and mobile (390px) viewports. All core functionality working: hero carousel with 5-frame auto-cycle and manual controls, Discord links with correct attributes, navigation anchors, countdown timer, mechanics story with 3 phases and SVG assembly, notebook gallery with 3 tabs, comparison table, privacy/terms pages, variant routes, SEO metadata, and keyboard accessibility.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile viewport (390px), comparison table shows 6 visible alternative columns instead of hiding all but the selected one. Mobile selector buttons exist but CSS column hiding not working correctly.
ui_bugs.expected: Only 1 alternative column visible (the selected one)

design_issues.issue: 29 text elements with font-size < 9px on mobile. Most are labels/captions which may be acceptable, but should verify legibility.
